# Stratify by severity and compute adjusted treatment effect
def compute_stratified_effect(df, strata_col='severity', treatment_col='arm', response_col='responded'):
    results = []
    for level in df[strata_col].unique():
        subset = df[df[strata_col] == level]
        n_treat = subset[subset[treatment_col] == 'treatment'].shape[0]
        n_control = subset[subset[treatment_col] == 'control'].shape[0]
        resp_treat = subset[subset[treatment_col] == 'treatment'][response_col].mean()
        resp_control = subset[subset[treatment_col] == 'control'][response_col].mean()
        effect = resp_treat - resp_control
        results.append({
            'severity': level,
            'n_treatment': n_treat,
            'n_control': n_control,
            'response_rate_treatment': resp_treat,
            'response_rate_control': resp_control,
            'treatment_effect': effect
        })
    return pd.DataFrame(results)
